notes: The head of the three-word 'by reason of' is the one debatable choice and is recorded in that unit's note; rule 24 puts it on the lexeme-carrying token rather than the connective.
'that they may behold thee' is divided under rule 52 — 'that' to the lamed, subject and modal to the infinitive — with the בְ unrepresented under rule 40 and its suffix taking 'thee'.
